name: WCB | Configurator Builder
author: Dons Digital

sections.description:
The WCB | Configurator Builder allows to you to create product configurations in WordPress and WooCommerce, with built-in support to visualize the changes in the product gallery image.

You can use this product configurator builder plugin to simply highlight your product configuration options. But you can also take the next step and combine the configurator with request a quote or add to cart functionalities.

Quick links:
– View all (PRO) features
– Explore live demos
– Browse add-ons
– Read our documentation

Use Cases

The WCB | Configurator builder is a multi functional configuration tool that can be used for various use cases, including but not limited to:

  1. Extra product options
  2. Visual configurators
  3. 3D configurators
  4. CPQ configurator
  5. Guided selling forms
  6. Composite products
  7. Product customizations

WordPress Product Configurator

The WCB configurator builder plugin is designed as a standalone plugin. You can use the shortcode to display your product configurator on any page you like.

WooCommerce Product configurator

If you are running a WooCommerce store, you can also use this plugin to extend your regular WooCommerce products and add extra product options, like input fields, swatches, and more.

This product configurator plugin integrates seemlessly with the WooCommerce plugin. Connect your configurations to WooCommerce products and build stunning product configurators and customizers with ease.

You can choose to extend simple products or variation products.

Use the WooCommerce checkout system to handle the online purchasing process.

Visual Product Configurator

Build visual product configurators with our product configurator builder tool. Add image layers, customize text and upload images.

You can also allow your customers to drag / resize the images in the desired positions.

Get the Visual controls add-on to drag and resize text and images on the product image.

3D Product Configurator

Step up your visual game with GLB 3D models. Change colors, update model parts and even show the 3D model in your own room using AR capabilities.

Get the 3D visual add-on to create stunning 3D configurations inside the WCB configurator plugin.

Request Quotes / CPQ Configurator

Allow your customers to ask for specific pricings using the request a quote feature of our plugin.

Simply link your configurator to your favourite form plugin or use the email button action and start collecting leads.

WooCommerce Cost Calculator

Get the advanced calculations add-on and create advanced price calculations using formula’s and tiered table prices

Features

Here is a complete list of features the free plugin has to offer:

  • Live image updates
  • Dynamic price updates
  • Drag and drop configuration builder
  • Pre-built configuration templates
  • Swatches fields
  • Label fields
  • Input fields
  • Tabs fields
  • Visual configurations
  • Send configurations via email
  • Request quotes via forms
  • Add configurations to cart
  • Multi language support

Add-ons

You can extend the free plugin features with various add-ons to get the most out of WCB configurator builder. You can also grab the bundle deal to get access to all add-ons at once.

Pro bundle features

Do more with the Pro plugin bundle, which gives you access to all our add-ons at once.

  • Image dropdown
  • Date picker field
  • Color picker field
  • Range slider field
  • File upload field
  • Repeater field
  • Panel options field
  • Multi step forms
  • PDF downloads
  • Add to wishlist
  • Save and continue
  • Conditional display
  • Percentage prices
  • Formula prices
  • Tiered table prices
  • Option weight management
  • Option SKU management
  • Option stock management
  • Linked WooCommerce product options
  • Horizontal and vertical slider swatch options
  • 360 degree 3D viewer
  • 3D visual updates (materials, parts, models, animations)
  • HDR backgrounds and scenes
  • Mobile AR display
  • Show QR code on desktop to launch AR on mobile

About

This plugin is developed and maintained by Dons Digital.
sections.installation:
1. Upload wcb-configurator-builder.zip to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
sections.faq:
Can I use this plugin without WooCommerce?

Yes! This plugin can be used in WordPress-based websites. You don’t need WooCommerce to build a product configuration.

Will this plugin work with my theme?

Yes, the plugin will work fine in all well-coded (block) themes

Does this plugin work with page builders like Elementor?

Yes, the plugin will work fine in page builders too.

How many configurations can I create with the plugin?

You can create an unlimited amount of configurations!

How many options can I add for each choice?

Depends on your server capacity, but we are confident the plugin handles up to 50 attribute options per choice (or more). There is practically no limit to the amount of options you can add.

Why do my configuration options not appear on WooCommerce products?

Make sure your product is purchasable. This means the WooCommerce product has a regular price set. If you want to start at 0, simply put 0 in the regular price field.

Can I add text and images to the product image?

Absolutely! You can personalize the product image with text and images using the text visual controls. For image uploads you need our advanced fields add-on.

Where can I find documentation?

You can find extensive documentation of our plugin on https://wpconfiguratorbuilder.com/docs/

Do you offer support?

If you have any questions, feel free to open a support ticket on our plugin page.
